basic_profile.bio: I am a 28-year-old tech enthusiast living in Austin, Texas. I work as a software developer by day, and by night, I'm usually found exploring the vast world of Destiny 2. I have a keen interest in speculative fiction and enjoy discussing alternate realities and what-if scenarios. I dislike unnecessary online drama and tend to avoid heated debates. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner, and we often game together. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for over 5 years. I am self-taught in gaming strategies and regularly engage in online forums to expand my knowledge. My interest in speculative fiction is fueled by a combination of academic study and personal exploration.
